Category creators and visionaries

Chainalysis is the most established name in blockchain analysis. From pioneering Reactor, the world’s first crypto investigation tool, to leading advances in fraud prevention, we raise the bar across products and services.

Data quality with the highest proven accuracy

Our proprietary architecture ingests data at scale, running hundreds of clustering heuristics while verifying accuracy with the industry’s lowest tolerance for error. We’re the only solution that has been subjected to Daubert scrutiny in court and undergone independent validation.

The largest intel team

Chainalysis has the largest intel team in the world, whose insights are augmented by our network of private and public sector customers and partners. We’re constantly expanding our data sets so that our users gain more complete insight.

Data coverage that captures what others miss

We capture the full sweep of activity, from on-chain behavior and smart contract events to the fiat rails where fraud often hides. We leverage AI to surface emerging threats before they strike, and our human-validated intelligence keeps the signal clean.

Single, complete platform

Chainalysis is not a point solution that solves narrow problems. We are the only platform that tackles use-cases across the full spectrum – from fraud and transaction monitoring to Web3 security and investigations.

Largest crypto network of 1500+ customers

Trust takes time to build, and it’s built on shared successes. We’ve helped law enforcement agencies seize tens of billions of dollars worth of illicit crypto, and helped financial institutions prevent their customers from sending hundreds of millions of dollars to scams.

Unmatched services & training

Our services teams have backgrounds in law enforcement, national security, regulation, tax, compliance, and data science. They support our customers through training and sophisticated investigations day and night in 15 languages.

Essential partnerships and integrations

We maximize value for our customers by collaborating with industry partners across technology, services, and distribution channels. We’ve created a powerful network that safely and securely supports cryptocurrency adoption.

Questions

Why do organizations choose Chainalysis over other blockchain intelligence tools?

Organizations choose Chainalysis because it provides a single blockchain intelligence platform that supports investigations, regulatory compliance, fraud prevention, and Web3 security on one consistent data foundation. Instead of stitching together point tools, teams can screen activity, investigate risk, and take action using the same underlying intelligence across products.

Data quality is the core differentiator. Chainalysis is widely recognized as the benchmark for blockchain intelligence accuracy and coverage, with advanced clustering, automatic token support, and cross chain tracing trusted by regulators, law enforcement, and courts. That rigor matters when decisions must withstand audits, litigation, or public scrutiny.

This trust shows up in adoption and results. More than 1,500 organizations, including nine of the top ten crypto exchanges and over 50 regulators across 100 plus countries, rely on Chainalysis as their shared source of truth. Customers have used the platform to freeze or seize over 34 billion dollars in illicit funds, detect the majority of major hacks before losses occurred, and identify billions sent to scams. In practice, higher quality data means fewer false alerts, faster investigations, and better outcomes.

Organizations choose Chainalysis because it combines trusted data, an end to end product portfolio, and proven real world impact in one platform they can rely on when the stakes are high.

Do all blockchain intelligence tools do the same thing?

Many blockchain intelligence tools appear similar in demos, but meaningful differences emerge in real operational use across compliance, fraud monitoring, security, investigations, and analytics.

The defining difference is data quality. Chainalysis prioritizes accuracy, validation, and depth, resulting in materially lower false positives than alternative solutions. Strong data allows teams to act decisively with confidence. Weak data creates noise, missed risk, and unreliable conclusions.

Isn't a basic blockchain intelligence tool enough?

Tools that look sufficient at first often struggle under real-world pressure. Higher false positives drain analyst time, slow investigations, and increase the likelihood that meaningful activity is overlooked. Gaps in coverage and limited expert support become especially costly in regulated or high-risk environments.

Chainalysis is built for situations where accuracy and defensibility matter. Its intelligence is trusted by regulators, admitted in court, and used by agencies that have helped seize more than $34 billion in illicit funds. When decisions carry regulatory, financial, or reputational consequences, reliability isn’t a luxury. It’s the baseline.

Why is Chainalysis’s data approach better?

Chainalysis’s data approach is built around four priorities that matter in real world operations: broad coverage, deep attribution, high accuracy, and rapid updates.

The platform supports new blockchains and tokens as they emerge, allowing teams to see new activity as it matters. Deterministic clustering links addresses controlled by the same entity, producing a clear and defensible view of on-chain behavior. Independent evaluations have shown that this approach achieves low false positive rates while maintaining strong attribution coverage.

This intelligence extends beyond on-chain data. Alterya expands visibility by linking blockchain activity with bank accounts, digital wallets, email addresses, phone numbers, and domains. By unifying on-chain and off-chain signals, teams can analyze real world identities and crypto activity together rather than in isolation.

What data does Chainalysis have that others don’t?

Chainalysis maintains the largest and most trusted map of the crypto economy. This dataset has been tested in regulatory investigations and landmark court cases, including undergoing a Daubert hearing.

What differentiates the data is not just scale, but signal depth.

Chainalysis combines blockchain activity with rich off-chain and open source intelligence such as legal entity information, jurisdictional data, web domains, and partner intelligence from firms like Lukka and Cellebrite. The platform also includes network and infrastructure insights derived from more than a decade of running full nodes and capturing historical observations that cannot be recreated retroactively.

This intelligence is continuously refined through real investigations and compliance programs across more than 1,500 organizations, creating a data flywheel competitors cannot replicate. The same dataset powers Web3 security and fraud prevention. Hexagate uses it for real time exploit detection, while Alterya uses it to identify scam infrastructure early across crypto and fiat rails. The result is a single, court trusted source of truth that surfaces insights other tools cannot see.

How does Chainalysis handle end-to-end compliance and investigation workflows?

Chainalysis is built as a unified platform rather than a collection of disconnected tools. Products support the full lifecycle of investigations and compliance from initial detection and attribution through case building, reporting, and enforcement.

Native solutions span investigations, compliance, fraud prevention, Web3 security, and advanced analytics, giving teams a consistent intelligence backbone. Where customers already have established systems, Chainalysis integrates into existing workflows so teams can upgrade intelligence without operational disruption.

Integrations support custody and wallet infrastructure, case management, KYC and AML systems, Travel Rule compliance, off-chain and OSINT data, mobile device forensics, tokenization, market surveillance, network intelligence, and white label exchanges.

Our roadmap focuses on streamlining workflows through increased AI and automation, helping teams move more efficiently from detection to resolution as volume and complexity grow.

Have Chainalysis claims been validated by third party review?

Yes. Chainalysis is the only blockchain intelligence provider whose data has been evaluated in a formal academic study against a verified source of truth. Results showed false positive rates below 0.15 percent and attribution coverage up to 95 percent for the entities analyzed. Independent validation of this kind is rare in the blockchain intelligence space and provides a clear distinction between marketing claims and proven performance.

Why do regulators and law enforcement trust Chainalysis?

Regulators and law enforcement trust Chainalysis because its intelligence is operationally effective and defensible in court. Agencies worldwide rely on the platform to investigate ransomware, sanctions evasion, terrorist financing, human trafficking, and large scale scams. Chainalysis data has supported high profile multi agency investigations and seizures.

More than 50 regulators use Chainalysis to inform policy and supervision. Public sector teams benefit from over a decade of blockchain intelligence experience and more than 500 combined years of investigative expertise, supported by formal training and certification through Chainalysis Academy. This trust mirrors why organizations across the private sector rely on Chainalysis as their primary source of blockchain intelligence.

How does Chainalysis stay ahead as crypto evolves?

Chainalysis continuously expands coverage to new blockchains, protocols, and tokens with automatic token support for tens of millions of assets, ensuring emerging risks are visible in real time. AI and automation across Rapid, Signals, and Data Solutions help teams understand complex activity faster, reduce manual effort, and act with greater confidence.

Beyond investigations and compliance, Chainalysis invests heavily in prevention. Hexagate delivers real time Web3 security to detect on-chain exploits, while Alterya identifies scam infrastructure and fraud across crypto and fiat rails before losses occur. Flexible deployment options allow organizations to adopt new capabilities securely as regulatory and operational needs change.

Built on verified, court tested intelligence and a continuous R&D roadmap, Chainalysis provides a single platform that scales with the ecosystem rather than forcing customers to re platform as crypto evolves.
